youtube.title: Babaji's YouTube channel
youtube.method: Public channel feed (newest 15). With a free YouTube Data API key in the YOUTUBE_API_KEY secret, the whole upload history.

gurmatveechar.title: Gurmatveechar.com, Babaji's katha folder
gurmatveechar.method: Reads the public folder listings once a day, one page per second, and records each recording's upload date once.
gurmatveechar.message: 37 series, 2333 recordings, 68 pages read, 0 dates looked up

programmes.title: Programmes (Google Sheet)
programmes.method: A Google Sheet published as CSV, set as programmes_csv_url in config.json.
programmes.message: Add the sheet's published CSV link to programmes_csv_url in config.json

banidb.title: BaniDB (Gurbani check)
banidb.method: Checks each quoted Gurbani line against its Ang in the BaniDB API (Khalis Foundation). Only the result is stored.

facebook.title: Facebook page
facebook.method: Meta Graph API with a Page access token (pages_read_engagement), granted by a page admin.
facebook.message: Add FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID and FACEBOOK_PAGE_TOKEN as repository secrets (docs/SOURCES.md).
